mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST is a leading indicator of consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 251.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening by the Fed and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods (CPIAUCSL > 251.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 24-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.5% and CPIAUCSL is above 250.0, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 1.5 and CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 36-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with unemployment below 3.5% and strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k increase), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overheating and Fed tightening, producing negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS growth > 100k), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 24-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing and economic activity, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 500,000 indicate strong consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered periods (RSAFS > 500000), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 250.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 250.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 36-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.
